description: Source code for the NEORV32 GPIO driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, read/write, and initialization functions.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_read
methods.description: Reads the current input register value for the GPIO device.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to the output register of the GPIO device.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a specific GPIO pin with given flags.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_port_get_raw
methods.description: Gets the raw value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets bits of the GPIO port based on a mask and value.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits in the GPIO port.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits in the GPIO port.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits in the GPIO port.

methods.name: neorv32_gpio_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO device, checking syscon device and features.
